1.

This second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 548 of 2018, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3 / 4 of D. P. Act, police station Roberstganj,
District Sonbhadra, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
The first bail application of the applicant-accused was rejected by the coordinate Bench this Court vide order dated 24.9.2021 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 22813 of 2019.

2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State as well as learned counsel for informant and perused the entire record.
3.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.
Applicant is husband of the deceased.

sentences.text: The allegation that deceased was being harassed on account of dowry, is wholly false.
It was stated that the deceased has committed suicide in fit of rage by consuming poison.

In post mortem report except one minor abrasion, no other injury has been shown and cause of death could not be ascertained, hence viscera was preserved and as per viscera report, aluminium phosphate was found in the viscera of the deceased.
It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail since 5.2.2019 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than five years.
The applicant has no criminal antecedent and that in case he is granted bail, he will not misuse liberty of bail and cooperate in the trial.

4. Learned A. G. A. as well as learned counsel for informant have opposed the application and submitted that the applicant is husband of the deceased and there is evidence that the deceased was being harassed on account of dowry.
It was stated that the deceased has suffered unnatural death within seven years of her marriage and that trial of the case is at advanced stage.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, all attending facts and particularly period of detention, without expressing any opinion, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Santosh Pal involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
